system.description:
Etching is the delicate skill of burning indelible symbols into metal by use of acid, tar and wax.

Obstacles: Simple figure, Ob 1. Simple landscape, Ob 2. Multiple figures, Ob 3. Complex scene with background, Ob 4. Life-like representation, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Alchemy, Illumination, Painting, Sculpture

Skill Type: Craftsman. Tools: Workshop.

Root: Agility

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 271
